positions.position: Hardcoding 'python:3.12' as a fallback in TS (Commands.ts and CellMetadataEditor.tsx) is acceptable because the RPC call could fail and we need a sensible default; the value is unlikely to change frequently.

The whole point of this PR is to centralize the default base image. Hardcoding 'python:3.12' in three places (backend pipeline.py, Commands.ts catch block, CellMetadataEditor.tsx constant) directly contradicts the goal and re-introduces the drift the PR claims to fix. Should resolve via a single source — either inject at build time or rely solely on the RPC value with a clearly marked emergency fallback constant defined once.

dissents.topic: Behavior change from empty string to explicit default

positions.position: Changing self.base_image = '' to self.base_image = DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE alters downstream semantics. Previously, the empty string allowed the jinja template's 'or' chain to fall through and let KFP apply its own default. Now Kale forces 'python:3.12' even in contexts (e.g. running inside a notebook pod whose own image we failed to detect) where the user might have wanted the kfp default behavior. The comment 'Use kfp default image' is now stale and misleading.
An explicit, predictable default is better than relying on KFP's implicit default which historically has been a moving target. Users will get reproducible behavior. Update the comment and ship.

dissents.topic: UX regression: replacing inline Input with modal dialog

positions.position: Replacing the always-visible Base Image input with a small 'IMAGE' button that opens a modal hides the current value behind a click. Users who previously saw the base image at a glance now have to open a dialog to inspect or edit it. This is a usability regression masquerading as a feature.

The button frees horizontal space and the InlineMetadata text below the cell now always shows the effective image (with '(default)' suffix), which is arguably better discoverability than an empty text input. Net neutral or positive.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE duplicated in multiple places, defeating the PR's stated goal
issues.detail: The PR introduces DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE = 'python:3.12' in backend/kale/pipeline.py but then hardcodes the same string literal again in labextension/src/lib/Commands.ts (catch fallback) and as an exported constant in labextension/src/widgets/cell-metadata/CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and the jinja template still uses 'python:3.12' as the final 'or' fallback in nb_function_template.jinja2 line 2 was changed but other call sites like the catch block won't update. When the version changes, three files must change in lockstep — this is exactly the bug the PR claims to fix. Consolidate to a single source of truth.

issues.description: Behavior change: base_image now forced to python:3.12 instead of deferring to KFP default
issues.detail: In pipeline.py _set_base_image, the exception/fallback path previously set self.base_image = '' which let downstream (KFP) apply its own default. The new code sets it to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE unconditionally. The retained comment '# Use kfp default image' is now stale and misleading — Kale, not KFP, now decides. This is a semantic change that should be called out in the PR description and the comment updated.

issues.description: UX regression: inline Base Image input replaced with hidden modal behind 'IMAGE' button
issues.detail: The previously always-visible Input control for Base Image is replaced by a small contained button labeled 'IMAGE' that opens a Dialog. Users lose at-a-glance visibility of the current per-step base image override and need an extra click to edit. The button is also disabled when stepName is empty, which is a new precondition not documented. Consider keeping the input inline or at least showing the current value next to the button.

issues.description: Button width style 'width: 5%' inside container is fragile and likely renders too narrow
issues.detail: The new IMAGE button uses style={{ width: '5%' }} inside a div with marginRight 4px. 5% of the parent will render as a sliver on most screens, clipping or wrapping the label. Either drop the width override (let MUI size by content) or use a sensible min-width.

issues.description: get_default_base_image RPC does a function-local import for no reason
issues.detail: In backend/kale/rpc/nb.py the new get_default_base_image function imports DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside the function body. The module already imports from kale.pipeline (or could) at the top level — function-local imports are appropriate only to break circular imports or avoid expensive load. Neither applies here. Move to module-level import for consistency and lint cleanliness.

issues.description: Default base image shown as '(default)' even when pipeline-level base_image is set
issues.detail: In InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, isDefault is computed as !this.props.baseImage, meaning when the step has no explicit baseImage but the pipeline has a pipelineBaseImage configured, the text will read e.g. 'Base Image: my-pipeline-image (default)'. That mislabels a user-configured pipeline default as the system default. The label should distinguish 'inherited from pipeline' vs 'system default'.

issues.description: defaultBaseImage initialized to empty string masks RPC failure
issues.detail: DefaultState in LeftPanel.tsx sets defaultBaseImage: ''. If commands.getDefaultBaseImage() throws or the component reads state before it resolves, downstream code receives ''. In InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText the chain falls through to the hardcoded DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE constant, masking the failure. Either initialize to the constant or surface the error state explicitly.

issues.description: Width adjustment from 35% to 30% on Select looks like leftover space-balancing
issues.detail: The dependencies Select width changes from 35% to 30% with no explanation. Combined with removing the 25%-wide Input, total row width budget changes. This is incidental UI churn that should either be removed or accompanied by a comment.

issues.description: Dialog 'Ok' button does not actually commit anything
issues.detail: updateBaseImage fires onChange of the Input via updateValue, so by the time the user clicks 'Ok' the value is already saved. The label 'Ok' implies confirmation; consider 'Close' or 'Done' to avoid implying that clicking elsewhere discards changes.

issues.description: Reordering of createBaseImageText after createLimitsText is unexplained
issues.detail: InlineMetadata.tsx swaps the render order so limits text now appears before base image text. Minor but unexplained UI change; if intentional, mention in PR description.

issues.description: Unused Dialog title 'Base Image for Step' uses sentence case while rest of app may differ
issues.detail: Minor stylistic consistency check — no other dialog titles shown in diff, but worth a glance at sibling dialogs to confirm capitalization convention.

issues.description: No tests added for the new RPC or template change
issues.detail: A new RPC endpoint (get_default_base_image), a new template variable (default_base_image), and a behavioral change in _set_base_image all ship without tests. A small unit test for the compiler rendering and a smoke test for the RPC would prevent regression when the default is bumped (e.g. python:3.13).

review.summary: The PR's intent — surface a single default base image in the UI — is sound, but the implementation undermines its own goal by hardcoding 'python:3.12' in three additional places (Commands.ts catch fallback, CellMetadataEditor.tsx constant, and an effectively-stale jinja literal pattern), so a future version bump still requires multi-file edits. There is also a meaningful behavior change in pipeline.py where the fallback moves from '' (defer to KFP) to an explicit Kale-chosen default, and the surrounding comment is now misleading. The biggest UX concern is the replacement of the always-visible Base Image inline input with a tiny 'IMAGE' button (styled width: 5%) that hides the value behind a modal. Several smaller issues — '(default)' label being technically wrong when a pipeline-level image is inherited, function-local import in the RPC, no new tests — should be addressed before merge. None of the issues are catastrophic, but the duplication and the silent behavior change in _set_base_image warrant a revision pass.
